# Discover Crew Technologies

> Discover Crew Technologies is a custom software development, SaaS engineering, AI automation, and AI marketing company founded by Rohith. Headquartered in India and serving clients worldwide, the company builds high-performance web applications, cross-platform mobile apps, cloud-native SaaS platforms, and intelligent business automation solutions.

## Core Services

- [Web Application Development](https://discovercrewtechnologies.com/services/web-development): Fast, scalable, SEO-optimized web applications built with Next.js, React, Node.js, and modern cloud architectures.
- [Mobile App Development](https://discovercrewtechnologies.com/services/mobile-development): Native and cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android engineered for intuitive UX and seamless API integration.
- [Custom Software Development](https://discovercrewtechnologies.com/services/software-development): Purpose-built enterprise software, internal tools, ERP solutions, and custom backend systems designed to solve specific operational bottlenecks.
- [AI & Business Automation](https://discovercrewtechnologies.com/services/ai-automation): Custom AI agent workflows, large language model (LLM) integrations, document processing pipelines, and autonomous operational automation.
- [SaaS Platform Development](https://discovercrewtechnologies.com/services/saas-development): End-to-end multi-tenant SaaS architecture, secure user onboarding, role-based access control (RBAC), and automated subscription infrastructure.
- [AI Marketing & Growth Automation](https://discovercrewtechnologies.com/services/ai-marketing): Data-driven technical SEO, automated marketing funnels, audience targeting pipelines, and conversion rate optimization (CRO).

## Flagship Products

- [Ventura AI](https://discovercrewtechnologies.com/products/ventura-ai): An intelligent AI-powered business management platform designed to automate everyday company operations and reporting.
- [Event OS](https://discovercrewtechnologies.com/products/event-os): Comprehensive event lifecycle management and ticketing operating system (currently under development).
